risks.risk: Controller brand/model and compatibility (PS4 vs other; original vs clone) are not readable, which affects value and buyer usability.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of any brand/model markings on the controller (back label/serial area) and the exact port/charging connector type; plus a short clip showing it pairing/working with a PS4.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/possibly non-original controller with no confirmed compatibility.

risks.risk: Condition issues like stick drift, unresponsive buttons, or worn triggers can’t be confirmed from static photos.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing: analog stick movement test (no drift), D-pad/face button presses, and trigger/shoulder button responsiveness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested/possibly faulty controls.

risks.risk: Charging method and whether a cable/dock is included are not shown; battery health/runtime can’t be verified.
risks.proof: Photo of the charging port and included cable/dock (if any), plus a clip showing it charging and holding charge (or battery indicator/runtime).
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/unknown charging accessories and battery health.

risks.risk: Connectivity type (wired/Bluetooth) and pairing reliability can’t be confirmed from photos.
risks.proof: Clip showing pairing to a PS4 (or wired connection) and stable input response for a few minutes.

risks.risk: Seller’s “hacked PS4 with 6 games” may be unrelated to the pictured item (controller only), creating a mismatch risk.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual PS4 console and all 6 game items (discs/cases) with readable titles, plus a boot-up video showing the games list.
risks.if_unproven: Price only for the controller shown, ignoring the game/console claims.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of controller brand/model/serial markings (front/back label) and any model number.
Video clip testing: both analog sticks (no drift), D-pad, face buttons, triggers/shoulders.
Photo of charging port and confirmation of included cable/dock (if any).
Clip showing charging and/or battery runtime (or battery indicator) after charging.
Clip showing wired/Bluetooth connection and successful pairing/working inputs on a PS4.
If selling the PS4 + games: photos of the PS4 console and all 6 game discs/cases with readable titles, plus a boot-up/game list video.
response.reason: The witness report consistently identifies a game controller in the photos, so it can be priced at its worst-case as an unknown/possibly non-original, untested controller. The seller’s PS4/game claims are not verifiable from the provided images.
